title: feat(record-page): one tab per related list, and an Overview rail that sums up the other tabs
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6v19uPsX6gX42G8tGcvvzb)_
Fixes #35595
Fixes #35596

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbSphdunq2aJq7ktuY

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到的变化：记录页第一个页签是「概览」，阶段条和关键字段只在概览顶部、占满整行；之后每张子表一个页签，空的灰显不带数字，放不下的才收进「更多」；附件、审批、动态各有页签，页面底部不再挂审批区和附件卡。概览右侧换成摘要卡：审批、附件、最近动态、其他有记录的子表，空的不显示，点标题进对应页签。右栏原来能拖动排序、隐藏子表卡片的按钮随卡片一起去掉；已保存的顺序和隐藏仍然有效，用「恢复默认顺序」「显示」可以还原。原来单个「相关」页签的旧链接会打开「概览」。
- 为什么：记录页改版专题里的页签规则和概览右栏两张卡，按您说的「列出所有子表、按宽度收下拉、右栏不显示空子表」来做。
- 如果判断错：只影响记录页的版面，不动数据和应用配置；最坏是页签顺序或右栏卡片不如预期，撤回这一次合并即可恢复。
- 需要您做的：无。改动约 4,600 行（三分之二是测试），超过 3,000 行，交审批人批准后合并。

## What changes

The record page's tab row and its right column are redrawn. This supersedes #28469 (empty lists sank into the dropdown even on a row with room for them); that partition is retired.

**Tabs (#35595).**
- Overview first, then one tab per side related list in `relatedLists` order, then Attachments, Approvals and Activity last.
- Every tab is there at first paint, and none moves when the counts land.
- An empty list keeps its place, greyed and with no number. A list whose count read is refused keeps its place with no number and is not greyed.
- The only fold is the row's width: the tabs that do not fit go into 「更多 N ▾」, and its items keep their counts. Approvals carries a dot while a request waits, not a count.
- A tab that merges several tables (only an explicit page can write one) carries no count (`page:tabs` computeCount: more than one probe, or more than one list shown).
- The stage path and key fields sit across the full width on Overview only. Every other tab draws its block in their place.
- A page drawn as written that places no approvals or attachments panel gets them as tabs of its first tab strip (`withFallbackRecordTabs`), not as bands at the page's foot.
- The header's approval tag opens the Approvals tab.
- A page with several `record:details` nodes draws its approval band once, on the first body that reaches it, recall included (`ApprovalBandOnceScope`, #35483 / #35484).

**Right rail (#35596).**
- On Overview, the right column sums up the other tabs in this order: Approvals, Attachments, Recent activity, then 「其他相关」 with one card for each side list that has records.
- Each card has a title that opens its tab, a grey count and at most three rows.
- A card with nothing to show is not drawn, and the 「还有 N 个空关联」 line is gone.
- Nothing in the rail is editable. A rail with no cards folds away.
- A drawer or pane (`embedded`) draws no rail and no right-column switch.
- The rail's rows come from the page payload (`RelatedCountStore.takeRows`). The rail does no read of its own unless the payload did not carry the rows. Under StrictMode an effect re-run finds the hand-off already spent, so each card caches its answer per question (`useSummaryRows`).

**Header region (#35679's fence).** After #35679 merged, I made two small edits there, and the coordinator approved both (claim amendment 7028805451):
- the approval tag's click opens the 审批 tab;
- the ⊟ right-column switch is not drawn when `embedded`.

The strip's move to Overview needed nothing in the header region.

**Size.** 66 files, +3315 / −1283 (about 4.6k lines). About two thirds of that is tests (3,046 lines of test and e2e changes). The 3,000-line split was lifted for this one PR.

## Tests

<details><summary>New pins</summary>

- `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordTabRow.widthOnly-35595.test.tsx`: the width-only fold, the muted empty tab, the 审批 dot, every tab at first paint with no moves (MutationObserver), and a refused count.
- `plugin-detail/src/synth/__tests__/recordTabRow.widthOnly-35595.test.ts`: the layout rule. The counts never decide a slot (CONTROL), and the partition is retired from the module.
- `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordPageColumns.readerArrangement-35595.test.tsx`: the stored arrangement still orders the tabs, and the reader move/hide controls are retired.
- `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailView.approvalBandOnce-35484.test.tsx`: two details bodies draw one band.
- `app-shell/.../RecordDetailView.fallbackRecordTabs-35595.test.ts`: approvals and attachments become tabs of the first strip.
- `components/src/__tests__/page-tabs-one-table-one-count-35595.test.tsx`: a merged tab carries no count; CONTROL, a one-table tab does.
- `app-shell/.../RecordDetailView.recordOpenRequests-12701.test.tsx`, new describe for #35484: an authored page with two details nodes shows 'Locked for approval' once, with one recall lever; CONTROL, the one-body page.
- `app-shell/.../RecordDetailView.approvalDeclaredActions.test.tsx`: the tag opens the 审批 tab.
- `ui/e2e/record-tabs-rail-35595.spec.ts` (Playwright, Chromium, zh-CN), each case with a CONTROL:
  - the fold: the row is sized from its own measured tab widths to hold exactly eight tabs plus the trigger (half a tab short of the ninth), with 「更多 4」 holding 任务 6 / 附件 2 / 审批 dot / 动态 4; CONTROL, every tab at 1184 px;
  - the Overview strip spans both columns at 1280 × 800;
  - the rail and strip are absent on another tab; CONTROL, back on Overview;
  - a rail card title opens its tab; the order is 审批, 附件, 最近动态, 其他相关, sized radius 8 / title 13 px / row 26 px.
</details>

<details><summary>Migrated and retired tests</summary>

- `plugin-detail/src/synth/__tests__/recordTabRow-28469.test.ts`, replaced by `recordTabRow.widthOnly-35595`
- `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedCardStack-27055.test.tsx` (RelatedCardStack is no longer drawn on the page)

All runs went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

After merging origin/main up to c321914fa4e (the tree of head 7557c0359b6; the later merge of ca4ec2a2f1b touched only `ui/packages/auth`):

- `vitest run packages/app-shell/src/utils … ObjectFieldInspector.relatedList-27054 RecordDetailView.harness` (after the #35691 merge): 61 files, 990 tests passed. These failed once against a stale `packages/spec` dist and passed after a rebuild.

## Acceptance notes

- **Reading correction.** The 「还有 N 个空关联」 line came from `RelatedListEmptyFold`, drawn through `RelatedCardStack` in the shared Related tab, not from the rail. Both are gone from the page, and RelatedCardStack and RecordTimelinePanel are now dead code on the page.
- Other readings that no longer hold (the cards were read at 7ece0204a6):
  - synthTabs sits at about lines 943–1033, not 938–1022;
  - `record-reference-rail.tsx:783` lives under `plugin-detail/src/renderers`.
- The Approvals tab exists only while the record has approval requests.
- On the laid-out page both the details band and the rail's 审批 card show. This is by design: the band is the record's status and the card is the summary.
- The authored strip has no width fold of its own.
- The ⊟ switch still shows on a full page whose rail folded away for having no cards.
- The split pane is `embedded` too, so it also loses its rail.
- The payload's `expand` is no longer read by the rail.
- The `relatedList` spec prose ("shared Related tab") has drifted. `packages/spec` is outside this PR's fence, so it is left for a spec-docs follow-up.
- The `KNOWN_LABEL_KEYS` line in containers.tsx is outside the tabs-container fence and was not touched.
- #35252: lint rule (d) measures `RECORD_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX` (6), not 4. Moving the strip into Overview does not change which fields the body omits, so the lint still holds as written.
- The Attachments tab re-reads once under React StrictMode (dev only), because RecordAttachmentsPanel's hand-off is take-once. It is outside this fence; noted in the 13010 test and not asserted.
- #35483's reach (a synthesized page falling back to tabs) is NOT MEASURED on its own page shape. The shared scope plus the DetailView-level pin cover it.
- The Playwright fold case does not use a fixed window width. CJK label widths depend on the installed fonts: a CI runner with no CJK font drew the twelve tabs in about 580 px, so a fixed 900 px window did not fold. The spec now sizes the row from the row measurer's own readings and asserts that the tabs together do not fit. It passes both with the CJK fonts present and with them hidden.
- **Overlap with #35755 (ux-2's #35599 card, `claude/issue-35599-record-edit-save`).** `overlap-check` exit 1, one file. One hunk collides in `RecordDetailView.tsx`, on the authored-page `SchemaRenderer` line: this PR wraps it in `ApprovalBandOnceScope` and feeds `fallbackTabs.page`; #35599 feeds `layoutPage`. Whichever lands second resolves by passing `layoutPage` into `withFallbackRecordTabs` (and as `page:` in its laid-out branch). My side of that hunk is three lines.

## Verification

Two-minute check: open a record that has several related lists on a 1280 × 800 window. Expect:
- Overview first, one tab per list, Activity last;
- the empty lists greyed with no number;
- on Overview, the right column shows 审批 / 附件 / 最近动态 cards, then 其他相关, each with at most three rows;
- clicking a card title switches to that tab, and the stage path and key fields disappear there;
- opening the same record in a drawer shows no right column and no ⊟ switch.

Read first:
1. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordSummaryRail.tsx`: `useSummaryRows` and the payload hand-off, where a missed hand-off becomes an extra read.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordPageColumns.tsx`: the tab list build and the Overview-only strip.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`: `fallbackTabs`, the approval tag click, and the `!embedded` switch.

Gates on head 7557c0359b6: the 49 families `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives were all run locally, and every one exited 0 (`--ran`: 49 derived, 49 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN). `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` passed (7 anchors judged, 0 lost). type-check for plugin-detail, components, i18n and app-shell passed after a closure rebuild. Playwright passed 5/5. The wide run belongs to CI.
